title: Predicting outcomes in radiation oncology--multifactorial decision support systems

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Predicting outcomes in radiation oncology--multifactorial decision support systems》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】With the emergence of individualized medicine and the increasing amount and complexity of available medical data, a growing need exists for the development of clinical decision-support systems based on prediction models of treatment outcome.

evidence.text: With the emergence of individualized medicine and the increasing amount and complexity of available medical data, a growing need exists for the development of clinical decision-support systems based on prediction models of treatment outcome.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】Even after initial development and clinical introduction, a truly useful predictive model will be continuously re-evaluated on different patient datasets from different regions to ensure its population-specific strength.

sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Predicting outcomes in radiation oncology--multifactorial decision support systems》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-2】In radiation oncology, these models combine both predictive and prognostic data factors from clinical, imaging, molecular and other sources to achieve the highest accuracy to predict tumour response and follow-up event rates.
